neighbours.label: Low-confidence guess: 'every' / the variable in a 'for every x there is/exists' statement in math or logic; the same statements phrased without a quantifier stay quiet.
fire: For every real number x there exists a larger integer.
For every epsilon there is a delta that works.
For every prime p there is a larger prime.
For every y in the range there is an x.
For every point on the curve there is a tangent.
For every n there exists a solution.
For every set there is a power set.
For every input there is exactly one output.
quiet: Some real numbers are larger than every integer.
Epsilon and delta are small numbers.
The curve has a tangent at the origin.

notes: Card: ' to' x3, ',' x3, ' for' x3, ' elements' x2 (because for⟦ every⟧ y there is one x); output promotes ' exist', ' exists'. Exploratory probe weak: 'For every x there exists' 0.20, 'For every y there is' 0.07.
